Class StartingTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.offerpath.StartingTile
public class StartingTile extends Object
Represents the starting tile of the game board, containing the individual starting blocks. Manages the initialization of these blocks based on the player count.

Each block carries food and prestige modifiers that are applied immediately when a player is placed on it (see StartingBlock.resolveEffect()), not at the end of the round. The block on which a player lands also determines their position in the turn order for the upcoming round; that order is exposed separately through getNextRoundOrder().

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(List<Player> players)
      Configures the starting blocks based on the total number of players in the game. Assigns the specific food and prestige modifiers for each position and places the players on their initial blocks for the very first round.
      Parameters:
      players - The list of players participating in the game.

    • placePlayerOnNextAvailableBlock

      public void placePlayerOnNextAvailableBlock(Player player)
      Places the specified player on the first available starting block. This automatically maintains the return order for the next round and immediately resolves the specific effect of the newly occupied block (e.g., food bonuses or prestige penalties).
      Parameters:
      player - The player returning to the starting tile.

    • placePlayerOnLastAvailableBlock

      public void placePlayerOnLastAvailableBlock(Player player)
      Places the specified player on the last available starting block (scanning the blocks in reverse order). As with placePlayerOnNextAvailableBlock(Player), the occupied block's effect (food bonus/cost or prestige penalty) is resolved immediately upon placement.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to place on the last available starting block

    • removePlayer

      public void removePlayer(Player player)
      Removes the player from their current starting block. This is triggered when the player moves their totem to an offer space.
      Parameters:
      player - The player leaving the starting tile.
